goregistries.description: A Go module namespace identified by the first component of a canonical module path (for example github.com or golang.org).

modules.description: A Go module available in the registry, including its metadata and published versions.

latest_version.description: The canonical Go version string reported by the GOPROXY @latest endpoint for this module. Module-wide, not a property of any single Version.

repository.description: VCS repository URL inferred from the module path. Module-wide, not a property of any single Version. Omitted when the mapping is not determinable, for example behind a vanity import domain.

major_version_suffix.description: The major-version suffix carried by the module path, for example /v2. Absent for v0 and v1 module paths. example.com/m and example.com/m/v2 are distinct modules and are therefore distinct Resources.

deprecated_message.description: The text of the '// Deprecated:' comment attached to the module directive in the go.mod of the module's latest version. Go carries module deprecation in a go.mod comment rather than in a directive or in proxy metadata. Not named 'deprecated' because that name is reserved by the xRegistry core.

retractions.description: The effective set of retracted version ranges for this module, aggregated from the retract directives in the go.mod of the module's highest non-retracted version. Retraction applies to ranges of versions and is declared by a later version, so it is a module-wide fact rather than a property of the retracted Version itself.

low.description: Lowest canonical Go version in the retracted range, inclusive.

high.description: Highest canonical Go version in the retracted range, inclusive. Equal to 'low' for a single-version retraction.

rationale.description: The comment recorded alongside the retract directive, if any.

declared_in.description: The canonical Go version whose go.mod declares this retraction.

name.description: The canonical Go module path, verbatim and unaltered, including any major-version suffix (e.g. 'github.com/pkg/errors', 'example.com/m/v2'). This is the authoritative name of the module; the moduleid is only an addressing key derived from it and MUST NOT be reversed to recover this value.

version.description: The canonical Go version string exactly as published, including the leading 'v' and any '+incompatible' build metadata (e.g. 'v2.0.0+incompatible'). This is the authoritative version; the versionid is a transliteration of it and MUST NOT be reversed.

modulepath.description: The canonical Go module path reconstructed from the group and module identity, including any major-version suffix.

info_url.description: GOPROXY .info endpoint URL for this version.

mod_url.description: GOPROXY .mod endpoint URL for this version.

zip_url.description: GOPROXY .zip endpoint URL for this version.

gomod_hash.description: The go.sum 'h1:' dirhash of the go.mod file, as recorded in the Go checksum database. The value is the literal 'h1:' prefix followed by the base64 SHA-256 hash-of-hashes, exactly as it appears on the '/go.mod' line of go.sum.

zip_hash.description: The go.sum 'h1:' dirhash of the module zip, as recorded in the Go checksum database. The value is the literal 'h1:' prefix followed by the base64 SHA-256 hash-of-hashes, exactly as it appears on the module line of go.sum.

pseudo_version.description: Whether this version is a pseudo-version (e.g. v0.0.0-20210101000000-abcdef012345).

pre_release.description: Whether this is a pre-release version.

incompatible.description: Whether the upstream version carries the +incompatible build-metadata suffix, which marks a major version at or above v2 published from a repository whose module path lacks the matching /vN suffix.

go_version.description: The language version named by the 'go' directive in this version's go.mod, for example '1.21.0'. Recorded without the leading 'go' keyword.

toolchain.description: The toolchain name named by the 'toolchain' directive in this version's go.mod, for example 'go1.21.4' or 'default'.

require.description: The 'require' directives of this version's go.mod. These are minimum-version requirements, not a resolved dependency set: the build list is computed by minimal version selection over the whole module graph.

path.description: Module path of the required module.

indirect.description: Whether the requirement carries the '// indirect' comment, meaning no package of this module is imported directly by this module.

replace.description: The 'replace' directives of this version's go.mod. Replacements take effect only when this module is the main module and are ignored when it is a dependency.

old_version.description: Specific version being replaced. Absent when the directive replaces all versions of the module.

new_path.description: Replacement module path, or a filesystem path when the replacement is a local directory.

new_version.description: Replacement version. Absent when the replacement is a local filesystem directory.

exclude.description: The 'exclude' directives of this version's go.mod. Excluded versions are skipped by minimal version selection and, like 'replace', take effect only in the main module.

path.description: Module path of the excluded module.

retract.description: The 'retract' directives declared by this version's go.mod. Each entry retracts a range of versions of this same module. The retracted versions are other Versions of this Resource and carry no marker of their own; the module-wide effective set is exposed by the 'retractions' meta attribute.

low.description: Lowest canonical Go version in the retracted range, inclusive.

high.description: Highest canonical Go version in the retracted range, inclusive. Equal to 'low' for a single-version retraction.

rationale.description: The comment recorded alongside the retract directive, if any.

godebug.description: The 'godebug' directives of this version's go.mod, as GODEBUG setting name to value, for example 'panicnil' to '1'. Applied only when this module is the main module.

tool.description: The package paths named by the 'tool' directives of this version's go.mod. Applied only when this module is the main module.

ignore.description: The directory paths named by the 'ignore' directives of this version's go.mod, whose contents are excluded from the module's file tree.
